Name: Saltcliff Farm
Author: tlitookilakin
TagLine: A new island farm map, designed to be pretty, functional, and moderately challenging. Includes a "secret" farm cave entrance behind a waterfall! Also includes an "easy mode" for those who want less of a challenge.
Description:
A brand new standard-size island farm map! Features all of the usual perks and limitations of the island farm map, plus more!
    - Renewable stumps on the left of the map!
    - Lots of berry bushes!
    - Farm cave entrance behind the lower waterfall!
    - Animal barriers on bridges and steps!
    - Benches to sit on and enjoy the view!
    - Easy Mode (disabled by default): Allows grass to be tilled and sprinklers to be placed on sand!

If you have any bugs or feature requests, let me know!
